item.description:
Dany's Video 0.4.22

  • The first public build. Dany's Video is a 3D VHS room for your own Jellyfin library: every film is a tape on the shelf, pull one out, put it in the VCR and it plays on the TV, from your server.
  • Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens without a warning. Updates arrive through Dany's Video → Check for Updates…
  • The app has its own identity now (studio.staiola.danysvideo). If you ran a private test build, sign in again: your room is restored from Jellyfin.
  • Every model in the room is credited in the ? panel, with its licence next to the file in the app.
